resolution.title: Choose the GATK 3.5 calling method
resolution.detail: The paper names GATK 3.5 but does not identify the caller or command. Somite will not substitute a modern HaplotypeCaller workflow because that can change the scientific method.

recipes.title: Recover the reported GATK 3.5 method
recipes.summary: Identify the exact caller and arguments before selecting an executable replacement.
steps: Search the methods, supplements, repository, and cited protocol for the caller name.
Record the GATK version, caller, arguments, filters, and reference preparation.
Choose or add a reviewed operator only when those details are supported.
